other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Applicant must not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for a continuous period of more than one year
Applicant must be contributing to the fund until the age of 60 years
Applicant must not have already received the benefit of this scheme two times
Spouse of a male employee who is a beneficiary of the fund is also eligible
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹5,000 credited within 15 days via DBT to eligible women or the spouse of a male employee, with the benefit available twice per beneficiary.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
